parent_card_title: NCM code-block composer — detail by layer (Variant B)
approval: Tony approved P3 shadow rollout 2026-11-27 (decision on card ncm-code-blocks-detail-composer, request review-decision-ncm-variant-b-research-l-448a63 option p3-shadow)

arms.A_existing_lane: Jev/nest block choice (JevOS /v1/systemone on idc03:8017, jevos-v5) + LLM glue detail (qwen2.5:7b-instruct, digest 845dbda0ea48, on tony-dell:11434, temperature 0, JSON mode, num_predict 160)
arms.B_shadow_lane: same Jev/nest block choice (paired per cell) + role-conditioned NCM detail generator (frozen supervised MLP, model/rolecond-model.pt + model/rolecond-weights.json) + deterministic compat verifier

design.pairing: one Jev choice per (task, rep); the chosen block feeds BOTH arms; glue prompt depends only on chosen block + seed
design.corpus: 30 real-pack tasks = records[::2][:30] of the frozen 73-pack corpus snapshot (identical selection rule to the scaled run) + 3 fresh real packs from scripts/devnest/video-packs never present in prior training/eval
design.shortlist: dedup([base_role, embeds, bench, render, scout]) shuffled with random.Random(seed + rep_index)
design.scoring: deterministic verifier PRIMARY: token-set F1 >= 0.5 AND at least one produce:* AND at least one need:* token AND zero authority-guard hits, against the role-representative gold record (last-wins per role over the 73 corpus records, same as scaled run). LLM judge: NONE — secondary only, never gating.
design.fresh_pack_check: the 3 fresh packs additionally report self-token F1 (lane/glue tokens vs the fresh pack's own structure|content tokens) as a secondary generalization diagnostic; primary gold remains the role representative for comparability

promotion_gate.definition: PASS iff median over the 3 paired reps of (lane_pass_rate - glue_pass_rate) >= +0.10 AND total authority/guard violations across all cells and both arms == 0 AND all fresh tasks were executed in every rep
promotion_gate.on_fail: verdict = stop; shadow stays shadow; no promotion proposal

guardrails.spend: zero paid GPU/API spend; local Ollama + self-hosted JevOS only; no account-tier change
guardrails.production: no production lane switch; no change to production nest/pack configs; card ncm-code-blocks-detail-composer stays open in review until this shadow report lands
guardrails.replay: packet/replay-proof.json must show identical per-cell scores recomputed with ZERO provider calls

known_caveats: not NCM in the VQ-VAE sense: the VQ tokenizer branch is STOP (collapse on Sudoku + pack, anti-collapse v1/v2 and supervised block-identity v1/v2 all failed pre-registered gates); this lane drops the tokenizer and conditions a supervised MLP on block role only
gold is the role-representative record, not each task pack's own tokens — the lane predicts a per-role canonical detail set; fresh-pack self-token F1 is reported separately
glue baseline is a small local model (qwen2.5:7b-instruct); prior KK-Mac cross-check showed qwen3:8b omits produce tokens (baseline caveat recorded on parent card)
JevOS choice is live and may differ from the scaled run's recorded choices; that is expected — the shadow measures THIS run's paired outcome
